answer.rationale: Current constraints: cannot rollback (security patch is mandatory per compliance), settlement peak means adding capacity would be slower than routing, regional failover is premature without confirming root cause. Read replica routing has proven fast recovery (memory_b5, day 55) and directly targets write path pressure by offloading dashboard/reporting load from primary. This preserves the mandatory security patch, uses existing infrastructure capability, and buys time to investigate the latency climb without customer impact during peak settlement traffic. Circuit breaker would fail writes we must preserve. This is a guarded escalation that maintains optionality for next intervention if needed.
